title: Rava, Brother or Father of Rav Mari bar Rachel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 154a; see also the entry Rav Mari bar Rachel.[^1]

notes.text: The saved Davidson Shabbat154a scalar gives Rava as brother of Rav Mari bar Rachel, with father as an alternative. Both relations remain alternatives; no preferred genealogy is imposed. Rav Mari is explicit in heading and pointer, while Rava and Rachel gain no added titles.
